item.tib: bsang brngan bsam 'grub yid bzhin nor bu
item.coloph: bsang brngan mchod pa'i cho ga snang srid zhi bde'i 'byung gnas/ las mtha' myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul/ smod lam 'grub pa'i nor bu zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rjes 'jug gyer spungs yab sras kyi rgyud 'dzin/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor pa blo ldan snying po zhes bya bas/ sngon gyi dpon gsas gong ma rnams kyi bka' lung gtsor bzhag nas/ bkod pa lags s+ho//
